forum.title: Removing the speed potentiometer functionality from STEVAL-PTOOL1V1_6S_HL example
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi ​@JStamwood

the easiest way to remove the potentiometer feature is the following:

before loading the IOC file into the Workbench, open it with a text editor. Scroll and find the line “MotorControl.M1\_POTENTIOMETER\_ENABLE”, change its value to “false”.

Save it and load it into the Workbench. At this time, you won’t be see the potentiometer flag anymore and the code will be generated with the standard API only.

Alessio
